# TAP on Doge

> TAP on Doge brings token mints and DMT experiences to Dogecoin through Doginals-aware wallets, transactions, and explorers.

## Public experience

- Home: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/tap-on-doge/
- Discover: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/tap-on-doge/reference.html
- Get started: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/tap-on-doge/guide.html
- Bitcoin Universe: https://inscribe.bitcoinuniverse.io/

## The experience

- Discover: Find Dogecoin-native token communities and their live asset stories.
- Mint: Join supported token or DMT mints through a compatible Doginals experience.
- Follow: Watch confirmed activity appear across Dogecoin-aware explorers and services.

## In plain language

- Dogecoin-native: Addresses, fees, funding, and confirmations all belong to Dogecoin.
- Token mints: Basic mint activity carries a ticker and amount.
- DMT mints: DMT activity follows the identity and block terms of its deployment.
- Doginals: Inscription-aware services connect the payload to its onchain history.

## User safety

Use Dogecoin addresses and Dogecoin-native wallets for these transactions. Confirm the asset type, recipient, inscription, funding inputs, and miner fee before signing.

## Community resources

- Explore Dogecoin TAP activity: https://tapalytics.xyz/
- Discover TAP: https://docs.tap-protocol.com/
